design_assets.title: Jarvis J·机甲星核母版
design_assets.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Create ONE final original JARVIS app logo, square transparent PNG. Reference image is only context for cyan/navy/silver and J + star identity. Completely REPLACE its circular silhouette.
MAIN SILHOUETTE: abstract futuristic robotic mech faceplate outline. Angular broad brow, clipped upper corners, tapered cheek edges and chamfered pointed chin. Broad pentagonal silhouette that evokes high-tech armor and robotic intelligence. No circle, ring, orbit, ears, headphones. No literal face, eyes, mouth, nose, screws, face seams, forehead panels, neck or body. Think abstract iconic robot helmet outline, not a 3D robot render.
INNER IDENTITY: large bold custom geometric silver-white capital J, flat slightly slanted top bar, straight stem and angular hooked lower end, integrated with the jaw geometry. Legible J occupies 50% height. Distinct four-point ice-cyan star in upper-right interior, balanced against J. J and star are ONLY internal symbols.
Use 4–6 confident architectural segments maximum, crisp contour, generous negative space. Thin platinum inner edge and restrained cyan luminous outer edge. Deep midnight navy interior. Mostly flat vector-like graphic with subtle satin tonal variation, NO photoreal textures, heavy bevel, gaming mascot aggression or reflective product render. No red/gold.
Emblem centered, 82% canvas height and 75% width. Genuine transparent outside including corners. Readable small app icon, exquisite optical spacing. No text except the J. No captions, mockup or watermark. Final production asset, not a concept sheet.
design_assets.inspection: Current mech silhouette + J + star assets; scoped verification in evals/reports/brand-ui.json.
